title: 'The Murders in the Rue Morgue,' by Edgar Allen Poe, Part One (2/3)
titleZh: 愛倫坡〈莫爾格街兇殺案〉第一部 (2/3)
summaryZh: 敘事者與杜邦同住巴黎，驚訝發現杜邦能看透人心，彷彿有兩個靈魂。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — American Stories

sentences.text: So I told him how I felt and asked him to come live with me.
sentences.zh: 於是我把心裡的想法告訴他，並邀他搬來跟我一起住。

sentences.text: He would enjoy using my many fine books.
sentences.zh: 他可以盡情享用我那許多珍貴的藏書。

sentences.text: And I would have the pleasure of company, for I was not happy alone.
sentences.zh: 而我也能享受有人作伴的樂趣，因為我一個人並不快樂。

sentences.text: We passed the day's reading, writing, and talking.
sentences.zh: 我們就這樣讀書、寫作、聊天，度過一天又一天。

sentences.text: But Dupin was a lover of the night, so often we walked the streets of Paris after dark.
sentences.zh: 但杜邦熱愛黑夜，所以我們常常在天黑之後漫步在巴黎街頭。

sentences.text: I soon noticed that Dupin had a special way of understanding people.
sentences.zh: 我很快就注意到，杜邦有一套獨特的方式看穿別人。

sentences.text: Using it gave him great pleasure.
sentences.zh: 運用這種能力讓他非常享受。

sentences.text: He told me once, with a soft laugh, that he could see through the windows that most men have over their hearts.
sentences.zh: 他曾經輕聲笑著對我說，他能看穿大多數人心上的那扇窗。

sentences.text: He could look into their souls.
sentences.zh: 他能直接看進他們的靈魂。

sentences.text: Then he surprised me by telling what he knew about my own soul.
sentences.zh: 接著他說出他對我靈魂的了解，讓我大吃一驚。

sentences.text: He knew things about me that I had thought only I could possibly know.
sentences.zh: 他知道一些我以為只有我自己才可能知道的事。

sentences.text: At these times, he acted cold and emotionally distant.
sentences.zh: 在這種時候，他顯得冷淡，情感也很疏離。

sentences.text: His eyes looked empty and far away.
His voice became high and nervous.
sentences.zh: 他的聲音變得又高又緊繃。

sentences.text: At such times, it seemed to me that I saw not just Dupin, but two Dupin.
sentences.zh: 每到這種時候，我彷彿看到的不只是一個杜邦，而是兩個杜邦。
